verdict.rationale: The Department's own pages describe the core transactions as online. Registration goes through the online Florida Business Tax Application, which the Department recommends. Reemployment tax returns (Form RT-6) can be filed electronically with an e-certification step. The eFile and Pay portal offers 'Start a New Return' and 'Make a Payment'. A live probe confirms the registration application serves a login entry at taxapps.floridarevenue.com. Missing for 10: the post-login transactions were not observed end-to-end, and the evidence covers almost only reemployment tax, with no sales or other tax filing flows shown.
